rationale: Manolo is building production-ready audio intelligence for voice AI systems, while Evan is creating Expo Agent—an agentic interface for deploying apps universally. Manolo's focus on studio-quality audio preprocessing and reliability in production aligns directly with the infrastructure needs of voice-first agents that Evan is building at Expo. Both are in San Francisco and thinking deeply about making AI systems work reliably at scale rather than just in demos.
intro_message: Manolo Espinosa, meet Evan Bacon — Manolo's work on audio reliability and preprocessing for voice AI could be core to the production readiness of voice-driven agents like Expo Agent.
